resources.string: Unlock your phone and confirm your identity in compatible apps with your fingerprint.
Your fingerprint complements your screen lock. After restarting, and whenever Android requires it, use your PIN, pattern or password.
You can add or remove fingerprints in Settings. Only register your own fingers if you want to keep access personal.
Keep your finger and the screen clean and dry. If you use a screen protector, make sure it supports the Galaxy S10 fingerprint sensor.
